title.value: DCA  Somerset County Scholastic (K-8 Grades) September 20th, 2026

body.value:
USCF Rated Scholastic tournament open to K-8 graders

Tournament Dates:

September September 20th, 2026

Tournament Format: Swiss

Sections Under 500 / Under 1000/ Under 1500

No of rounds : 4

Time Control: G/25; d/5

Prizes and Awards 

  • 🏆 1st Place Trophy in each Section
  • 🏆 2nd Place Trophy in each Section
  • 🏆 3rd Place Trophy in each Section
  • 🏆 Top K-3 Trophy in each Section
🥉Medals for all players who tie for 3rd place

Registration fee - $40

First round starts at 1.30 pm and ASAP (Please be there by 1.15pm)

Location - Knights of Columbus, Somerville (495 E Main St, Somerville, NJ 08876)
 

Registration Link - Register here 
(Registration will be closed once reached the capacity)

We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to seeing you there!
We run 2 QUADS and 1 Scholastic(K-8) tournaments each month

For more information & Questions please contact DCA via dashchessacademy@dashnmore.com
